title: Complexity, curvature and homological dimension of modules under linkage
summary: In this article, we analyze how (projective and injective) complexity, curvature, and complete intersection dimension behave under linkage of modules and ideals. Let $R$ be a Gorenstein local ring. Consider a Gorenstein perfect ideal $\mathfrak{a}$ (e.g., $\mathfrak{a}$ is generated by an $R$-regular sequence). Let $M$ and $N$ be two Cohen-Macaulay $R$-modules linked by $\mathfrak{a}$. We prove that $\mathrm{cx}_R(M)= \mathrm{inj\,cx}_R(N)$ and $\mathrm{curv}_R(M)= \mathrm{inj\,curv}_R(N)$.
